property_summary: For any caller and any calldata, calling C.forward(callee, data) must invoke the external call on the `callee` argument, not on msg.sender; the bug ignores `callee` and routes the call to msg.sender, which can be detected by a recording helper whose fallback stores the observed call count so a caller-address check distinguishes them.
change_summary: Change the call target from the `callee` parameter to `msg.sender`, so the forwarded call goes to the caller instead.
